capstones.name: Rage of Rallos Zek
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, +50% damage, +30% attack speed, immune to all control effects. The god of war's rage.
capstones.description: Rallos Zek's own rage fills the warrior. None can stand before it.

capstones.name: Repel the Wicked
capstones.effect: Massive AE: 2000 + (level × 15) damage to all undead/evils in range. Knockback. Stun for 1 rounds.
capstones.description: The paladin repels the wicked with divine force.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Repel the Wicked AE (2000+(levelx15) vs undead/evils, damage author). Stun 6s ~1 round. Knockback via combat engine.

capstones.name: Dying Grasp
capstones.effect: Execute: if target is below 15% HP, instantly kill (no resist). Deals 3000 damage otherwise.
capstones.description: The shadowknight's grasp claims the dying.

mechanics.notes: Execute: if target is below 15% HP, instantly kill (no resist). Otherwise deals 3000 damage.

capstones.name: Torrent of Fists
capstones.effect: For 5 rounds, +40% damage on AE attacks.
capstones.description: A torrent of fists overwhelms all enemies.

capstones.name: Escape
capstones.effect: Instant: drop all aggro, become invisible (improved), +50% run speed for 5 rounds. Cannot be seen.
capstones.description: The rogue vanishes completely — the perfect escape.

capstones.name: Decapitation
capstones.effect: Passive: 8% chance on hit to instantly kill humanoid targets below 25% HP. Works on most humanoids.
capstones.description: The berserker's axe seeks the neck. Heads roll.

mechanics.description: Passive: 8% chance on hit to instantly kill humanoid targets below 25% HP. Works on most humanoids.

capstones.name: Frost Arrows
capstones.effect: For 50 rounds, bow attacks deal +400 cold damage and slow target by 30% for 1 rounds.
capstones.description: The ranger's arrows carry winter's bite.

mechanics.notes: HYBRID: self buff (+400 cold bow dmg) is buff author's. Slow applies on every bow hit, 1 round.

capstones.name: Chameleon Strike
capstones.effect: Strike for 1500 + (level x 10) damage, -80% hate. Warder +50% damage for 5 rounds.
capstones.description: Like a chameleon, the beastlord strikes unseen then fades.

capstones.name: Dance of Blades
capstones.effect: Aura (20 rounds): enemies take -25% weapon speed, -30 to resists. Allies gain +20% damage.
capstones.description: The bard's blade-dance cuts enemy effectiveness.

capstones.name: Sanctified Blessing
capstones.effect: For 30 rounds, 40% chance for heals to grant a divine blessing: +500 HP shield for 5 rounds.

capstones.name: Spirits of Nature
capstones.effect: Summon 4 nature spirits for 20 rounds: one heals, one nukes, one slows, one buffs. Each is powerful.
capstones.description: The full spirits of nature answer the druid's call.

mechanics.description: Summons 4 nature spirits for 2 minutes: one heals, one nukes, one slows, one buffs. Each is powerful.

capstones.name: Tigir's Insects
capstones.effect: AE debuff: -40% attack speed, -30% movement for 15 rounds.
capstones.description: Tigir's insects swarm and cripple the enemy.

capstones.name: Haze
capstones.effect: AE debuff: -40% accuracy, -25% attack speed, 20% chance to stun on cast for 20 rounds.
capstones.description: A haze of confusion cripples the enemy.

mechanics.notes: Stun-on-cast proc: when a debuffed enemy casts, 20% chance to stun ~1 round.

capstones.name: Heart of Flames
capstones.effect: Aura (30 rounds): self + pet deal +400 fire damage per hit. Immune to fire. Enemies take 150/tick fire aura.
capstones.description: The magician's heart burns with elemental flame.

capstones.name: Embalmer's Carapace
capstones.effect: Lich upgrade for 50 rounds: +30% mana regen, +25% DoT damage, -20% damage taken.
capstones.description: The embalmer's carapace perfects the lich form.

capstones.name: Fury of Ro
capstones.effect: For 20 rounds, fire spells +60% damage, +30% crit chance, +20% mana efficiency. The Tyrant of Fire's fury.
capstones.description: Ro's fury consumes the wizard's enemies in flame.
